reason: The repository workflow architecture is consolidated to one canonical PR CI, one release workflow and one maintenance workflow. Release-branch-only publication was verified at 4.4.295, and the active protect-main ruleset now targets the default branch with an empty bypass list, PR-only source integration, the GitHub Actions ci status check, conversation resolution, deletion protection, and force-push protection.

componentWorkflows.purpose: single pull-request quality context covering every normal merge gate
validate exact current main source and publish deterministic latest-only generated artifacts to the release branch without generated writes to main
weekly/manual governance, risk and workflow lifecycle validation

enforcementPlan.why: One unfiltered pull-request context protects source integration while generated userscript publication occurs on a dedicated release branch, so main remains PR-only without an Actions bypass.

branchProtectionTarget.singleMaintainerException: No independent reviewer is currently available. Owner acceptance is explicit and the single mandatory automated CI context is the primary compensating control.

branchProtectionEvidence.verificationMethod: Repository owner applied the active GitHub ruleset through Settings and supplied visual evidence in the approved task session.

bypassActors.purpose: SLF Release workflow publishes generated release commits to the release branch

releaseBranchProtection.platformLimitation: GitHub does not allow the GitHub Actions application as a ruleset bypass actor in user-owned repositories (422 on Integration actor 15368). Pull-request and non-fast-forward rules would block the automated release push, so the ruleset keeps deletion protection only; direct-push integrity is monitored by the SLF Maintenance drift check and registered as QR-009.
releaseBranchProtection.verificationMethod: Repository owner created the ruleset through the GitHub API with a classic PAT (repo, workflow scopes); verified via GET /repos/MostDef2000/SLF/branches/release returning protected: true and via the SLF Release run for 4.4.308.

connectorLimitation: The connected GitHub tool set does not expose branch-protection or ruleset mutation actions. The required manual platform step was completed by the repository owner and is now recorded as applied and verified.
